authoritative_cell_estimator.method: Retain the frozen V23 runner method exactly: for each cell, collect 12 paired candidate/reference elapsed-time ratios, exercising all six portable/reference/candidate execution orders twice, then take the ordinary median of the 12 paired ratios.
authoritative_cell_estimator.printed_precision: The runner emits the cell ratio with exactly six digits after the decimal point. The authenticated analyzer parses that emitted finite positive value; the independently printed candidate_ns and reference_ns medians are reporting fields and their quotient is not substituted for the paired-ratio median.
authoritative_cell_estimator.aggregation: Overall and broad-stratum values are equal-cell-weight geometric means of the authenticated emitted cell ratios, computed as exp(fsum(log(ratio))/count).
authoritative_cell_estimator.threshold_comparison: All thresholds are inclusive. A cell equal to 1.050000 does not count as over 1.05; a cell equal to 1.100000 satisfies the maximum guard.
authoritative_cell_estimator.p95_reporting: Sort all 1,944 authenticated emitted cell ratios ascending and select the one-indexed nearest rank ceil(0.95 * 1,944) = 1,847. This statistic is reported but is redundant with the stronger at-most-19-cells-over-1.05 gate.
authoritative_cell_estimator.tail_count: Count exactly the authenticated cells whose emitted ratio is strictly greater than 1.050000. At most floor(0.01 * 1,944) = 19 may do so.
authoritative_cell_estimator.maximum: The maximum over all 1,944 authenticated emitted cell ratios must be at most 1.100000.

inventory_hard_failures: Anything other than exactly 1,944 unique frozen case keys
Any missing or duplicate case key
Any missing or duplicate prepared artifact pair
Any non-finite or non-positive timing or ratio field
Any unpaired execution or wrong repetition/order inventory
Any artifact, code-size, fixture, window, outcome, or version mismatch
Any semantic, ABI, audit, mutation, identity, or guard-page mismatch
scope: This clarification freezes an ambiguity in the prospective v2 text. It changes no implementation, workload, membership, timing method, threshold, or terminal rule.
